_what: An agent-readable directory of people and topics. Read this JSON, choose a topic, then send the five request fields to the profile router. Koe never authorizes a request.
_note: Illustrative demo: all six people are fictional and have NOT been World ID verified. All profiles share one real Yohaku demo router and policy; requests do not reach these fictional individuals. No personal answers are delivered.

personhood.note: Intended listing policy: World ID verification before publishing. This static directory does not implement verified publishing, revocation or one-person-one-profile. Existing World verification is available as a separate Yohaku approval demo.

answers.200: Inspect verdict: deny means refused; auto is not proof of payment. Inspect settlement separately.
answers.202: human: held for a human decision, not approved or paid.
answers.402: Inspect verdict and payment details: eligible auto requests require a payment authorization. This example does not sign or pay.
answers.deny: A routing verdict, not an HTTP status. Do not retry with payment to override refusal.

howToAsk.note: The shared demo router is authoritative. Listing a topic is not permission. Earlier rules, grant expiry, price, counterparty history and current configuration can change the response. No distinct recipient field or personal policy exists for these demo profiles.
howToAsk.preconditions: Examples use a counterparty preloaded in the demo, a future deadline and prices within the shared threshold for auto topics. who is a caller-supplied demo label, not verified agent identity. A new counterparty may require human review.
howToAsk.paymentNote: JPYC is the request model currency. The deployed demo payment rail uses testnet USDC; read the returned asset, network and atomic amount. A listed JPYC amount is not a claim of JPYC settlement.

profiles.name: Alice
profiles.headline: Buys groceries for four. Notices packaging.
profiles.about: I do the weekly shop for a household of four and I read labels properly. If something goes back on the shelf, I can tell you exactly why.

profiles.name: Kenji
profiles.headline: Commutes 90 minutes each way. Has opinions about timetables.
profiles.about: Two trains and a bus, twice a day, for six years. I can tell you what a delay actually costs a person.

profiles.name: Mei
profiles.headline: Quit three fitness apps in a year. Can say exactly when.
profiles.about: I start things. I also stop them, and I remember the moment I stopped caring.

profiles.name: Tomás
profiles.headline: Assembles furniture badly. Reads the manual afterwards.
profiles.about: If an instruction can be misread, I have misread it. Useful, apparently.

profiles.name: Yuki
profiles.headline: Writes a paper diary every night. Has never posted it anywhere.
profiles.about: Twelve years of handwriting that has never been scraped, because it has never been online.

profiles.name: Sam
profiles.headline: Drinks coffee they cannot afford. Tastes the difference.
profiles.about: I will tell you what it actually tasted like, not what the packaging said it would.
